Questions for the hombres- 

You hear your tool belt clanking and a power tool running and your wife/partner is not in sight- 

Are you running at the speed of lightning to stop whatever madness is about to happen or are you letting it play out?💃🪚💣#buildingreality #felzmedia #joeandalx #womenandpowertools #girls

This is how my page works: I say I will do something crazy and then you see me *actually* doing it.

I said I was going to build a roof completely out of solar panels & here it is- twenty 625w panels sealed with 8 tubes of Durotán, which can produce 12,500 watts of energy every hour on a homestead only takes around 30,000 PER MONTH. 

Now for my next crazy idea: I would like to give all the excess energy to the Costa Rican government for free on the condition that they pass it to indigent Ticos who cannot pay their power bills.

This will be harder to accomplish than building the solar roof but one I day I hope to show you the canceled bills of some well deserving Costa Ricans 🇨🇷☀️🆓 #joefelz #solar #costarica #PurposeDriven #ManOfAction
